title: Db and Main
description: Study the implementation in [src/db.h] and [src/main.c]. Trace its declarations and dependencies into a caller or test. Inspect imports, declarations, and call sites in the file; filenames alone do not establish its role.

learning_objectives.text: Explain the source role and visible behavior in src/db.h, src/main.c.
Trace a declaration, setting, or documented claim to a caller, test, or implementation path.
Separate source evidence, documentation claims, and unverified runtime behavior.

completion_criteria: Submit the code-trace exercise meeting all acceptance criteria.
